blocks.text: MEMPHIS, Tennessee — Ajay Mitchell scored a career-high 35 points, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander added 28 and the Oklahoma City Thunder beat the Memphis Grizzlies 128-97 on Friday night in an NBA Cup group stage game. Oklahoma City has won 16 straight over Memphis, including a four-game sweep in the first round of the 2025 playoffs. Jared McCain finished with 21 points for the Thunder, who shot 55%.
